# sirf.

> sirf. is a media and content house for branding, personal branding and high-end content production: photography, video and brand films, social content systems, campaigns and event consultancy. It works with five clients at a time, never a sixth, so every client gets a senior team and full attention. "Sirf" is Hindi and Urdu for "only".

sirf. works with founders, leaders and brands who care about quality: it builds the brand (identity, positioning, voice), produces the content (shoots, stills, edits, films) in-house, and runs the system that gets it seen. Clients spend about six hours a month with sirf., with a dedicated account manager and content feedback three times a week. For events, sirf. offers event consultancy and full event media and production, including a personal brand film for the organiser.

## Services

- [Branding and brand identity](https://www.sirf.website/#identity-art-direction): visual language, tone of voice and art direction that ties films, posts and pages together
- [Personal branding for founders and leaders](https://www.sirf.website/#personal-branding): positioning, voice, founder-led posts, recurring series and short-form video
- [High-end photography and video production](https://www.sirf.website/#media): an in-house team for shoots, stills, edits and brand films; event photography, multi-camera talk recording, clips and recap films
- [Social media content systems](https://www.sirf.website/#content-systems): repeatable formats, editorial series and a publishing rhythm for LinkedIn, Instagram and YouTube
- [Profile optimisation](https://www.sirf.website/#profile-optimisation): LinkedIn, Instagram and YouTube profiles rebuilt so visits turn into follows and leads
- [Campaigns and launches](https://www.sirf.website/#campaigns-launches): the campaign idea, the rollout and the creative, across digital and out-of-home
- [Event consultancy](https://www.sirf.website/#event-consultancy): concept, venue, run of show, guest list, partners and the media plan
- [Scaling and distribution](https://www.sirf.website/#scaling-distribution): offer, pricing, ideal customer, sales process and where organic and paid content should go

## How onboarding and the work go

1. Foundation: the client gets access to a client dashboard and answers onboarding questions. sirf. builds a custom growth roadmap (ideal customer, how to attract and convert them, what makes the brand different) and presents it on a one-on-one call.
2. Economics: sirf. analyses the business, KPIs and stats to find the lowest-hanging fruit, such as raising prices, targeting a higher-value ideal customer and adding a back-end offer, before working on top-of-funnel content.
3. Momentum: a dedicated account manager (the client's one point of contact) meets the client weekly in the first month, with content feedback at least three times a week.
4. Amplify: sirf. runs the content system that works and tightens the whole sales process, so organic attention converts into clients at a profit.

## What makes sirf. different

- Five clients at a time, never a sixth: each client gets full attention instead of a slice of it.
- One thing in focus per client at a time, finished properly before the next.
- One point of contact from start to finish; no handoffs to people the client hasn't met.
- Senior people on every deliverable.
- About six hours of the client's time per month, with regular check-ins with the account manager and content feedback three times a week.

## Who it is for

Founders and personal brands, consumer and D2C brands, VCs and startups, and creators and media businesses who care about quality and want a partner rather than a vendor.

## Principles (the sirf. method)

1. Listen: one conversation, done properly; learn the business before touching the brand.
2. Commit: one brief, one dedicated team.
3. Craft: the frame, the grade, the sound mix, the caption; the last 10% is where excellence lives.
4. Deliver: finished, on time, nothing half-done. Then the next thing.

## Client perks (the inner circle)

Every sirf. client gets every perk, with no tiers: full attention (five clients at a time), a dedicated relationship manager, a monthly coffee catch-up with the team, a private invite-only circle of the founders sirf. works with, access to sirf.'s shortlist of high-end creative vendors (photographers, stylists, set designers, studios, fabricators), invite-only events around the country (coming soon), and small-batch sirf. merch.
